description: This file provides utility functions for handling TypeScript files within a project. It includes functions for resolving paths, identifying test files, collecting TypeScript files from directories, analyzing code violations, and utility functions for AST node manipulation and execution context detection.

methods.name: getTypeScript
methods.description: Lazily loads and caches the TypeScript module.

methods.name: resolveRepoRoot
methods.description: Resolves the repository root directory based on a given import URL.

methods.name: resolveSourceRoots
methods.description: Converts relative source root paths into absolute paths based on the repository root.

methods.name: isTestLikeTypeScriptFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path matches test-like suffixes indicating test or utility files.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects TypeScript files from a target path, with options to include/exclude test files and node_modules.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFilesFromRoots
methods.description: Collects TypeScript files from multiple source root directories.

methods.name: collectFileViolations
methods.description: Reads files and applies a violation-finding function to detect code issues.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Converts an AST node to its corresponding line number in the source file.

methods.name: getPropertyNameText
methods.description: Extracts text from various property name node types.

methods.name: unwrapExpression
methods.description: Removes parentheses and type assertions from an expression AST node.

methods.name: collectCallExpressionLines
methods.description: Traverses AST nodes to find call expressions and records their line numbers.

methods.name: isDirectExecution
methods.description: Checks if the script is being run directly as the main module.

methods.name: runAsScript
methods.description: Executes a main function if the script is run directly.
